purpose: Internal launch and contract preparation checklist. Customer versions live in config/offers.json.
build_foundation_acceptance: Page titles/descriptions match the agreed page plan; sitemap URLs and crawl/indexing directives match the approved launch policy. Record Search Console connection or missing access; do not report submission or indexing without evidence.
Verify one browser-tab icon and one approved default sharing image resolve, and inspect page OG/social title, description and image metadata. Provider preview caching and cropping may vary.
Verify the agreed domain resolves, the HTTPS certificate is valid for it and HTTP redirects to the intended HTTPS URL; record any provider dependency.
Record responsive, keyboard, contrast and contact checks with dated evidence; distinguish form save from notification and receiving-mailbox delivery.
Client can access the agreed accounts and delivery folder; the delivered source builds using its instructions, and service dependencies, licenses and unresolved items are named.
One initial launch is checked on the agreed hosting account. Any ready-service links/embeds match the approved scope; no excluded service setup or software is implied.
one_off_remedy: Before payment, itemize the fixed deliverables and the value allocated to each milestone. If cancelled or blocked, reconcile completed accepted work and approved unavoidable third-party commitments against payments; refund unearned amounts. Do not invent a retrospective hourly cap or fee. A new scope needs written agreement before more work.
annual_refund_timing: Initiate the agreed refund within ten business days of the effective service end, or cancellation confirmation before service starts, and provide an itemized settlement. Return undisputed unearned money within that deadline even if other work or amounts remain disputed. Bank or processor posting time is separate.

decision_pack_examples.assumptions: Hypothetical fee scenarios assume $20/month hosting and $120 of other provider costs over twelve months. These invented amounts are not provider quotes; replace them with approved actual charges. Unknown fees remain unknown. Taxes and additions are excluded.
